title: Supervisor (systemd service management) + disk-table de-noise — v0.6.1
scopeNote: v0.6.x supplement on top of the shipped toolbox. (1) Supervisor = systemd .service management as a 4th toolbox tab (list/status + start/stop/restart/enable/disable), NOT supervisord — both target distros are systemd and the codebase already shells systemctl (scheduler/nginx/firewalld). Tiered protected-units guard. (2) Disk-table de-noise: df -PTB1 adds an fstype column so the docker-overlay/pseudo rows can be filtered (default-hidden, UI toggle to show all). Stateless — no migration. Swap-write stays deferred (not in this cut).

phases.name: Disk de-noise — df -PTB1 + fstype column + shared isRealFilesystem/PSEUDO_FSTYPES + web default-filter + 'show system filesystems' toggle + parser tests

Supervisor backend — services-driver (systemctl list-units/list-unit-files parse + start/stop/restart/enable/disable via sudo -n), SERVICES_DRIVER token + Unavailable fallback, toolbox status 'services' feature, controller routes, shared schemas + protected-units guard (single source in shared), guardrail tests
Supervisor web UI — /toolbox 'services' tab (list table + per-row lifecycle actions, protected buttons disabled via shared helper), use-toolbox hooks, i18n (en + zh-TW)
docs/toolbox.md (systemctl sudoers alias + Services section + protected-units note), release v0.6.1 (bump 0.6.0 -> 0.6.1, no migration), Rocky 234 smoke

directionDecisions.S1_supervisorKind: systemd .service management (NOT supervisord). Both supported distros are systemd; codebase already uses systemctl (scheduler restart_service, nginx reload, firewalld driver). supervisord rejected: niche, needs separate install, high distro variance.
directionDecisions.S2_writeScope: Full lifecycle (start/stop/restart/enable/disable) with TIERED protection: SELF (dinopanel.service) refuses ALL mutation; CRITICAL set (sshd/ssh, firewalld, ufw, NetworkManager/systemd-networkd, dbus/dbus-broker, systemd-logind, systemd-journald) refuses stop+disable but allows start/restart/enable; everything else fully allowed. Guard lives in shared (single source) so server enforces + web disables buttons.
directionDecisions.S3_diskDenoise: df -PTB1 adds an fstype column (POSIX, never localized). Server returns ALL filesystems incl. fstype; the web default-hides pseudo/overlay rows via shared PSEUDO_FSTYPES + a 'show system filesystems' toggle. Filter by fstype (not path) so an unusual-but-real mount is never hidden.
directionDecisions.S4_persistence: stateless — no drizzle table, no migration, live systemctl query only. No staged/confirm window needed because self-mutation is hard-refused outright.
directionDecisions.S5_privilege: reuse TOOLBOX_REQUIRE_SUDO. Reads (list-units/list-unit-files) need no sudo; mutations run sudo -n systemctl <action> -- <unit>. Extend the DINOPANEL_TOOLBOX sudoers alias with systemctl start/stop/restart/enable/disable *; the protected-units denylist is enforced in CODE (sudoers can't encode 'all except self').
